Class OverloadSelectionTck

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.OverloadSelectionTck
public abstract class OverloadSelectionTck extends AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
Overload selection: the phases of strict, loose and variable arity invocation, the most specific method, accessibility of candidates and explicit descriptors. Each generated call must choose the overload javac chooses for the same call on a compiled fixture.

A backend runs these tests by extending this class and implementing AbstractByteCodeWriterTck.write(io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.ObjectDef).

Since:
2.3
